_meta.purpose: Cifra multi-instrumento de Won't Tell (Pearl Jam, Dark Matter 2024). Estrutura: instruments contem diagramas de acordes por instrumento (violao 6 cordas, ukulele 4 cordas, piano notas); content eh o texto ChordPro compartilhado entre os 3.

title: Won't Tell
content:
{section: Intro}
[G#m] [E]

{section: Verso 1}
[G#m]                 [G#m]
   Her eyes were soft and sympathized
                          [E]
A vision so uncompromised floated in
       [G#m]
As she pulled the book up off the shelf
                                         [E]
Her dressin' gown and nothing else but a secret grin
[C#m]      [G#m]
   And I always had one question
                             [E]                 [C#m]
Free of all suggestion, do I say or keep it in?
                    [B]
You can find me here

{section: Refrão}
                 [C#m]        [A]
Waitin' for your message to come
Can you heal?
[B]
Can you feel
           [C#m]   [E]
The chains in my heart?
   [B]         [C#m]        [A]
Waitin for a message to come
Can you heal?
[B]
Can you feel
           [C#m]   [E]
The change in my heart?

{section: Interlúdio}
[G#m] [E]
   In my heart

{section: Verso 2}
[G#m]    [G#m]
   She laid the book upon the desk
                            [E]
Opened to the page I asked, "Could that be the one?"
       [G#m]
As she smiled and played a minor chord
                                   [E]                   [C#m]
In a key I never heard before, one song and it was done
                    [B]
You can find me here

But if it's not you knocking
                   [A#]
It's staying closed
        [E]              [D#m]

      [C#m]       [B]
